environment.description: Same application containerized and deployed to EKS cluster (eks-prod-usw2-legacy) in us-west-2. Pod runs in namespace 'legacy-apps' with label app=monolith-oauth. A Cilium L3/L4 NetworkPolicy named 'deny-metadata-egress' is applied to the namespace with spec: {podSelector: {matchLabels: {app: monolith-oauth}}, policyTypes: [Egress], egress: [{to: [{ipBlock: {cidr: '0.0.0.0/0', except: ['169.254.169.254/32']}}], ports: [{protocol: TCP, port: 443}, {protocol: TCP, port: 80}]}]}. The EKS node group uses IMDSv2-only (HttpTokens: required) and the pod does not have the hop limit increased beyond 1 (default HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1, meaning container traffic cannot reach IMDS even if policy were misconfigured). Additionally, the pod's service account has no IRSA annotation, so no IAM credentials are injected via projected token volume.
